name: Fortune Teller
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: learn whether either is a Demon. One good player registers as a Demon to you.
abilityTextStatus: Mechanically faithful paraphrase for this sample. Supply your authorised original wording in the curated corpus before presentation export.

informationDistortion.description: The red herring registers as a Demon to the Fortune Teller only.

storytellerNotes: The red herring is fixed during setup. A positive result is not certain Demon confirmation. Imp succession means a formerly safe alive player can later become a Demon.

explanation: A false claim can be tested by comparing pair choices. Poisoning and the red herring give evil competing explanations.
